scheduleNotes: Official: Session 1 is printed in the official final answer key, and the official paper file is named 'DA24S1'. Secondary: several education sites report that DA was held on 3 Feb 2024 in the forenoon slot (9:30–12:30 IST). This is consistent with Session 1 being the first session of GATE 2024, but no official schedule table could be read from the build environment, and the GATE 2024 exam-date range itself is corroborated only by secondary sources.

Official: Session 5 is printed in the official answer key, and the official exam dates (1, 2, 15 and 16 Feb 2025) were confirmed through official-domain search. Secondary: several education sites and first-hand candidate posts report that DA was held on 15 Feb 2025; the sites report the forenoon slot (9:30–12:30 IST), which is consistent with Session 5 if sessions are numbered chronologically. The official per-paper schedule table could not be read from the build environment.

Official: Session 8 is printed in the official answer key, and the official exam dates (7, 8, 14 and 15 Feb 2026) were confirmed through official-domain search. Secondary: several education sites report that DA was held on 15 Feb 2026 in the afternoon slot (14:30–17:30 IST), consistent with Session 8 being the last of eight sessions. The official per-paper schedule table could not be read from the build environment.
